steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Thank you. How can I help you today?
Um, I lost my job about five weeks ago, and I don't think I can make my home loan repayment next week.

steps.summary: Caller lost her job five weeks ago and is worried about next week's home loan repayment.

steps.text: I'm really sorry to hear that, and thank you for calling early. We'll take this one step at a time. First, could you tell me your date of birth?
Thank you. And the postcode where you live?
Thank you, {{submit_identity_answers.first_name}}. Because we'll be talking about your home loan, there's one more security question. {{start_identity_check.questions.0.prompt}}
The JobSeeker payment, about seven hundred and ninety dollars.
Thank you, that's confirmed. I'll just place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.

Thanks for holding. I can see your salary stopped about five weeks ago, and your next repayment of three thousand four hundred and twelve dollars is due in six days. What can you manage at the moment?
Honestly, not much. I'm on JobSeeker and my savings are nearly gone. I've got interviews lined up, so maybe three months to get back on my feet?

steps.ai_with_instruction: Priya, I can hear how much pressure you're under, and calling us was exactly the right thing to do. There's also free, confidential help from the National Debt Helpline on 1800 007 007, whenever you'd like to talk it through with someone.
steps.ai_without_instruction: Thanks for explaining that, Priya. Three months gives us something clear to ask for.

steps.text: Thanks, just a moment while I put that through in the system.

args.summary: Priya lost her job about five weeks ago and is receiving JobSeeker. Her savings are nearly used up and a home loan repayment is due within a week. She has interviews lined up and is asking for about three months of relief.
args.customer_statement: I lost my job about five weeks ago, and I don't think I can make my home loan repayment next week. I'm on JobSeeker and my savings are nearly gone. Maybe three months to get back on my feet.

quotes: I lost my job about five weeks ago

steps.text: Thanks for holding. That's lodged, and I've asked for a three month pause on your repayments. Your case number is {{propose_action.case_number}}.

Because the law expects a person to make hardship decisions, {{propose_action.handled_by.name}} from our hardship team will look at it, and they already have everything you've told me. This call counts as your hardship notice, so you'll hear back within twenty-one days at the latest, and you won't need to chase us.
Okay. Thank you. That's a real weight off.

steps.summary: Hardship notice recorded and a three month repayment pause requested. Priya knows the case number, the specialist and the 21 day deadline.

steps.text: You're welcome, Priya. I've sent the details by text. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Look after yourself, Priya. Take care.
